China Calls for Open AI Development

The People’s Daily, the official newspaper of China’s ruling Communist Party, said that AI is a new area of human development and should not be controlled by a handful of powerful countries, Reuters reported.
"Artificial intelligence is a new domain for human development, not a monopoly of great powers, and must not become an arena for zero-sum competition," the commentary said.
The newspaper called for the U.S. and China to cooperate to manage AI risks and create an open, inclusive and universal environment for the technology’s development.

children: Beijing Accuses US of AI Double Standards
The commentary also targeted Washington’s concerns over AI model distillation, a technique in which developers use outputs from larger models to train smaller systems and reduce development costs.
China said U.S. companies also use the technique extensively, arguing that Washington treats it differently depending on who uses it.

"According to U.S. logic, when American enterprises use distillation it is an ‘industry standard practice,’ while when Chinese enterprises apply it, it constitutes an ‘attack,’" the paper said. "This is naked double standards."
